rebuild.howProved: The whole family directory was copied aside after the first rebuild and compared with diff -r against the second. Zero differences across every file.

pixelMeasurement.method: pdftoppm, 300 dpi, greyscale. For each named field a window is taken around the placed extent padded 2pt, and dark pixels (grey < 200, the threshold that reproduces VF08's counts exactly) inside that window but OUTSIDE the widget's own /Rect are counted three ways: the delivered page before, the delivered page after, and the pinned JDF-2371 rendered directly by poppler, which applies 12.5.5.
pixelMeasurement.reproducesVF08: Exactly. VF08 recorded 716 and 4605 delivered against a conforming baseline of 4 and 0, i.e. 5317 pixels of ink the delivered pages carried that the form does not. The outside-rect count now equals the form's own, count for count.
pixelMeasurement.theWriteSitsInsideItsRect: Yes. After the rebuild the sweep finds every one of the 81 flattened placements per fixture landing on its own /Rect within 0.05pt, so nothing this family stamps reaches the page outside the widget it belongs to.

sweep.method: VF02's sweep as VF08 generalised it: for every flattened widget placement in the fixture, compose the page-content cm operators, read the placed XObject's /BBox and /Matrix, transform the BBox by /Matrix, match the placement to the source widget whose /Rect origin it translates to, and require cmScale x requiredScale to equal 1 -- judged as |transformedSize x cmScale - rectSize| <= 0.05pt.
sweep.theNineBefore: 3J.1 (overhang 42.79pt) and 3J.2 (220.96pt) on page 2 are the two VF08 rastered as delivering ink outside their rects. The other seven -- 3D.1 and 4D.2 on page 2, CoS_Date and two GroupCoS widgets on page 3, 4A.3.3 and 4D.1 on page 5 -- deviate by 0.001pt to 0.166pt; VF08 classified the ones it counted as INK_CONFINED_TO_ITS_OWN_RECT. This sweep's 0.05pt threshold is stricter than VF08's and so reads more of them.
sweep.note: The sweep script is a measurement tool run from /tmp and is not committed.

pagesChanged.claimNotMade: Not every other page is pixel-identical, and this row does not claim it. The shared option repairs every mis-mapped placement in the packet, not only the two VF08 rastered, so three pages of each fixture move rather than one.
attributionAt300dpi: page 2: 5857 differing pixels, 5312 of them outside a mis-mapped widget's own rect -- the 3J.1 and 3J.2 overhang the repair removes. The remaining 545 lie inside the rects of 3J.1, 3J.2, 3D.1 and 4D.2.
page 3: 1087 differing pixels, 4 of them outside a rect -- the 0.166pt GroupCoS overhang the repair removes, at x 134.16.
page 5: 3084 differing pixels, none outside any widget's own rect.
pagesChanged.conclusion: Every pixel that moved anywhere in either fixture is either ink outside a widget's own /Rect that the repair removes, or ink inside a mis-mapped widget's own /Rect that the 12.5.5 fit resizes. No pixel moved anywhere else.
